content.tex: B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 4 to 6)
PRODUCTION BOUNDARIES (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This task is about the number of computer tablets and mobile phones a company makes and sells.
The company owns two factories, A and B. Factory A makes A-tablets and A-phones. Factory B makes B-tablets and B-phones.

A production boundary is a curve or line. Points on the curve or line are the maximum numbers of the two items a factory can make when all resources are used. It is the boundary of the region which shows all the combinations of the two items a factory can make.
